title: 7 November in Bapa’s Diary
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Bhagatji Maharaj returns to Akshardham
story: At the age of 68, Brahmaswarup Bhagatji Maharaj passed away to Akshardham in Mahuva after a lifetime dedicated to seva, bhakti and propagating the glory of Akshar-Purushottam as propounded by Bhagwan Swaminarayan.
